_comment: Provenance pin for the only file in this folder copied from the authors' release: their
BioNetFit model IGF1R_fit.bngl, from the S2 Compressed File Archive of the article. It is
vendored byte-identical; verify_erickson2019.ipynb refuses to use it if its sha256 differs.
table1_this_study holds the seven estimates the authors' BioNetFit placeholders take, as the
article's Table 1 prints them. Everything else in the folder is written or generated here.
publication: Erickson KE, Rukhlenko OS, Shahinuzzaman M, Slavkova KP, Lin YT, Suderman R, Stites EC, Anghel M, Posner RG, Barua D, Kholodenko BN, Hlavacek WS (2019). Modeling cell line-specific recruitment of signaling proteins to the insulin-like growth factor 1 receptor. PLoS Comput Biol 15(1):e1006706. doi:10.1371/journal.pcbi.1006706 (PMC6353226)

publisher_copy.item: S2 Compressed File Archive of the article, pcbi.1006706.s013.zip
publisher_copy.contents: IGF1R_fit.bngl, IGF1R_fit.conf, F5B.exp, F5D_20min.exp, F5D_60min.exp: the files BioNetFit processed to estimate the Table 1 parameters (S2 caption).

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
license.applies_via: supporting information of the open-access PLoS Computational Biology article
license.attribution: Erickson KE et al. (2019), PLoS Comput Biol 15:e1006706, S2 Compressed File Archive.
license.changes: None. The file is renamed with an erickson2019_upstream_ prefix to sit in the flat reference/ directory; its bytes are unmodified.

reference/erickson2019_upstream_IGF1R_fi.role: The authors' BioNetFit model: rules, fixed constants (NA 6.02214e23, Vecf 2.1e-9 L/cell, 20000 IGF1R per cell) and seven fitted constants as X__FREE__ placeholders, with the protocol of all three fits in its actions block: 24 pM (30350 copies) labeled IGF1 for 2 h, wash, 20 and 60 min cold-IGF1 scans (Kiselyov Fig 5D); then 7 pM (8852 copies) labeled IGF1 with a 4 h cold-IGF1 scan (Fig 5B).

S2 Compressed File Archive/IGF1R_fit.con.used_for: Read, not run: BioNetFit settings of the fit (objfunc = 2, weighted least squares; divide_by_init = 1) and the bounds of the seven loguniform_var parameters.

S2 Compressed File Archive/F5B.exp, F5D_.used_for: Their values are already committed as reference/kiselyov2009_fig5b_competition_digitized.csv and reference/kiselyov2009_fig5d_dissociation_digitized.csv.

table1_this_study._source: Erickson et al. 2019, Table 1, column 'This Study', 'Estimate' (article full text, PMC6353226). a'2 is not a placeholder: Table 1 gives it as 52 from Eq 1 and the unrounded estimates; the file derives it from the rounded ones (54).
